message.content:
This editorial illustration features a magazine cover layout against a landscape at dusk or dawn. The background depicts a pink and blue sky over a dark blue foreground surface reflecting two silhouettes. Two human figures, entirely in black silhouette, ride two black silhouetted horses. Both riders sit upright, facing away from the viewer. The horse on the left is positioned slightly ahead of the horse on the right. Both horses are walking forward.

At the top, the large teal word "TEMPO" is centered, with "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" in smaller teal letters below it. Above "TEMPO," text reads "LIPUTAN KHUSUS: TOKOH SENI 2017." A large white headline reads "SIASAT SETERU LAMA." Below this, smaller white text reads: "PEMILIHAN PRESIDEN 2019 DIPERKIRAKAN MENGULANG DUEL EMPAT TAHUN LALU. BAGAIMANA STRATEGI KOALISI PARTAI PENDUKUNG PRABOWO SUBIANTO MENGHADAPI JOKOWI?"

In the bottom right, white text includes "15-21 JANUARI 2018," "RP 45.000," and "WWW.TEMPO.CO." A barcode with the number "00047" and "9 770126 427302" is at the bottom right corner. A solid red vertical band runs along the left edge.
